description.value: Two Sparrows Cupcakes & Coffee Bar is a specialty cupcake shop and espresso bar located inside Woodgrove Centre, Nanaimo's large enclosed mall on the Island Highway. The menu spans a full range of espresso-based hot and iced drinks, frappes, dirty sodas, and handmade cupcakes, with gluten-free and vegan options available on request. For a touring cyclist passing through north Nanaimo, it offers a sweet resupply and a quality coffee stop in a covered indoor setting.

address.value: #112 6631 Island Hwy N, Nanaimo, BC (Woodgrove Centre)
